messages:
Alex Kim: Heads-up — acme-corp opened an escalation: per-model throughput charts in Console are flatlined since last night’s deploy. They say API calls are succeeding but the per-model QPS lines are gone. Ticket #INC-8921. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/example
Maya Patel: Thanks Alex. Any error logs from the exporter or prometheus? Did they change models or tags on their side?
Alex Kim: I asked for logs, they attached a grafana panel screenshot and said all models show 0 QPS while account-level totals look normal. No changes from customer side. They pointed at our release notes ~23:40 that mentioned metric relabeling for exporter v2.4.
Ingrid Sørensen: Can you paste the original PromQL used by the panel? I suspect label key changed.
Alex Kim: Panel query (old):
```
sum by (model_id) (rate(redwood_model_requests_total[1m]))
```
Customer's exporter now emits label `model` (and `model_name`) instead of `model_id` after the relabel step in v2.4.
Maya Patel: That matches. If the dashboard was written for model_id, queries will return nothing. Two quick options: 1) patch dashboards to use new label, or 2) add relabel_configs in prometheus to copy `model`->`model_id` until dashboards are migrated.
SRE OnCall: Quick check — prometheus scrape targets show new metrics. I ran:
```
{__name__=~"redwood_model_requests_total"}
```
and got series with labels: model="gpt-6-optimized", model_name="gpt-6 (opt)", region="us-west-2" — no model_id.
Alex Kim: Customer wants immediate visibility; asked for ETA. They’re okay with a temporary fix.
Ingrid Sørensen: I'll push a relabel rule on the metrics ingestion side. Proposed relabel in prometheus scrape_config:
```
relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: ["model"]
    target_label: "model_id"
```
This will rehydrate model_id for dashboards. Will deploy to shared prometheus in 10m if no objections.
Maya Patel: Please double-check for collisions (two labels with same model) and make sure we don't duplicate series. Also update docs and notify monitoring owners.
SRE OnCall: Rolling the relabel now to the prod prometheus scrape for exporters. Patch applied to scrape job `redwood-exporters`. I’ll monitor series cardinality for 15m.
Support Bot: Ticket INC-8921 updated: temporary relabel applied; dashboards should resume in ~60s. Notifying customer.
Alex Kim: Customer confirmed they can see per-model lines again. Closing loop: they want a permanent plan — either exporter emits both labels for backwards-compat or Console dashboards accept flexible label names.
Maya Patel: Action items:
- Ingrid: propose exporter change to emit `model_id` + `model` (compat) (owner: eng-ml)
- Product: add fallback mapping in Console queries to accept either label
- Docs: note label contract in telemetry migration guide
- Support: follow up with acme-corp and close after documenting workaround
Ingrid Sørensen: I’ll open PR to exporter repo to add compatibility labels and link to this thread. ETA end of week.
SRE OnCall: Monitor OK — no unusual cardinality. Will remove temporary relabel after exporter rollouts are confirmed.
Alex Kim: Thanks team. Leaving the ticket open until the exporter change lands. :thumbsup:
_meta: generated: realistic support thread about dashboard flatlining after metric label change
